admission.justification: Synchronous work must not starve polls or release ordering while a cancelled worker can still mutate shared state.

applicability: Registered synchronous MCP handlers on one AgentsRememberMCP server.
conditions: FastMCP continues validating arguments, injecting context and converting results.
Potentially mutating synchronous calls share that server's ordering lock until their worker exits, including cancellation.
exclusions: Existing asynchronous handlers retain their event-loop path.
Centrally read-only handlers and the explicitly classified context/check/preview modes bypass this lock.
The process-local log-budget lock does not replace cross-process file exclusion.
statement: Synchronous MCP handlers execute off the event loop with per-call ContextVars, while potentially mutating synchronous calls retain FIFO ordering until their worker exits.
